free_tier.stated: 400 compute minutes a month per namespace; 5 users per top-level group; 10 GiB of repository storage

per_object_cap.stated: 3 hours per job on GitLab.com hosted runners, regardless of the timeout configured in a project; the monthly pool and the cost factor bind first

retention.stated: artifacts expire per job configuration, default 30 days; compute minutes reset on the first of the month

egress.terms: the container registry is excluded from the namespace storage quota; storage beyond the purchased amount is billed

interface_detail: a .gitlab-ci.yml pipeline; instance runners on GitLab.com; self-managed runners are free of the vendor cap
tooling: the runner images; any shell; docker-in-docker on the Linux runners
chaining: the only free pool here with a cost-factor discount that makes open-source work cheaper: 0.5 for a GitLab-for-Open-Source project and 0.008 for a public fork of one

limits.value: 400 compute minutes a month on Free; a job consumes duration divided by 60 times the cost factor
cost factor 1 for small Linux, 2 for medium, 3 for large, 6 for xlarge, 12 for 2xlarge, 6 for macOS M1
10 GiB of repository storage per namespace

limits_note: a 1,000-minute grace period exists before jobs are dropped when the quota is exceeded; the 300,000-minute cap applies only to the community-contribution programme

identity_cost.detail: an email address registers the account; running jobs on GitLab.com shared runners on Free needs credit/debit card details, checked by a one-dollar authorization that is not charged; the CI documentation states the check follows a risk score and may ask for an email, a phone number or a payment method; a namespace that brings its own runner or disables shared runners needs no card

confidence_note: the compute-minutes doc and the storage-quota doc were read.

evidence.proved: 'Free tier namespaces receive 400 compute minutes per month'; cost factors small 1, medium 2, large 3, xlarge 6, 2xlarge 12; public projects in GitLab for Open Source 0.5 and public forks 0.008; usage resets on the first day of the month

evidence.quote: Free tier namespaces receive 400 compute minutes per month.

running jobs continue until the namespace is 1,000 compute minutes over quota
